FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1: Why do people choose treatment in India?
FAQ.a1: India combines high-level medicine — hospitals accredited by JCI and NABH, doctors with international experience — with prices 60–80% lower than Europe, the US and often Turkey. For patients from Uzbekistan, the availability of Russian-speaking support also matters.
FAQ.q2: Do I need a visa for treatment?
FAQ.a2: Yes, citizens of Uzbekistan need an Indian medical visa. We help obtain an invitation from the hospital and prepare the full document package — this usually takes several working days.
FAQ.a3: The cost depends on the diagnosis, the scope of the procedure and the chosen hospital. After reviewing your documents we send a written estimate before travel — you know the price in advance. Indicative price ranges are published on this website.
FAQ.q4: Is support available in Russian and Uzbek?
FAQ.a4: Yes. Your coordinator communicates in Russian and Uzbek, and medical interpretation is provided at hospital appointments and procedures.
FAQ.q5: How quickly can I travel for treatment?
FAQ.a5: Doctors provide an opinion on documents within 2–3 days. With documents ready, travel is usually possible within 1–2 weeks, including visa processing.
FAQ.q6: What happens after I return home?
FAQ.a6: You receive your discharge summary, recommendations and a follow-up plan. We stay in touch: online consultations with your treating doctor are arranged after you return to Uzbekistan.

cardiology.name: Cardiology & cardiac surgery
cardiology.about: India is one of the world leaders in cardiac surgery: highly complex procedures are performed in JCI-accredited hospitals at a fraction of European prices. Patients from Uzbekistan have access to everything from angioplasty to bypass surgery and valve replacement.

oncology.name: Oncology
oncology.about: Cancer treatment in India follows international protocols (NCCN) and uses modern equipment: linear accelerators, robotic surgery, targeted and immunotherapy programmes. Leading cancer centres — Tata Memorial, Max, Apollo and Medanta — welcome international patients.

orthopedics.name: Orthopaedics & traumatology
orthopedics.about: Joint replacement and spine surgery in India are performed on modern equipment with implants from leading global manufacturers and rehabilitation following international protocols. This is one of the most requested specialties among patients from Uzbekistan.

urology.name: Urology
urology.about: Indian urology centres specialise in minimally invasive kidney stone treatment (laser, no cuts), prostate surgery, kidney transplantation and urological oncology — at prices significantly below Turkish and Israeli clinics.

neurosurgery.name: Neurosurgery
neurosurgery.about: Highly complex neurosurgical procedures — brain tumours, aneurysms, spine pathologies — are performed in Indian neuro-centres equipped to world standards with neuronavigation and intraoperative monitoring.
procedures: Deep brain stimulation (DBS) for Parkinson's disease

HowItWorksPage.title: Your path to treatment in 6 steps
HowItWorksPage.subtitle: Full-cycle support: from your first message in the messenger to follow-up after you return to Uzbekistan.

step1.title: Free consultation
step1.desc: You send medical documents (reports, scans, test results) via the form or WhatsApp. Your coordinator replies in Russian or Uzbek and tells you exactly which documents are needed for your case.

step2.title: Indian doctors' opinion
step2.desc: Your documents are reviewed by a specialist from a leading hospital. Within 2–3 days you receive a medical opinion, recommendations and a treatment plan — this second opinion is free and obligates you to nothing.

step3.title: Estimate and clinic choice
step3.desc: We send a transparent written estimate: treatment, stay, diagnostics. If needed we offer 2–3 hospital options to compare — you choose what suits you.

step4.title: Visa processing
step4.desc: The hospital issues an invitation for a medical visa. We help gather documents and book an appointment — the whole procedure usually takes a few working days.

step5.title: Arrival and treatment
step5.desc: We meet you at Delhi airport, help with accommodation near the clinic and provide an interpreter at appointments and procedures. Your coordinator stays in touch 24/7 throughout treatment.

step6.title: Discharge and care at home
step6.desc: After treatment you receive a discharge summary in Russian, recovery recommendations and doctors' contacts. After returning to Uzbekistan we arrange online follow-up consultations.
